verdicts.reason: A is basically a scaled-down copy of the square layout: the headline, CTA, ZERO SUGAR and FIZZBANG text are all too small to read, and the yellow circle has come loose from the can and drifted right, where it reads as a random blob with the NEW FLAVOUR badge stuck to it. There's also a lot of dead blue space. B actually rearranges for the banner: a big left-aligned headline, the logo top-left, and the can on the right with its yellow backdrop. But the Grab a Can CTA is small and gets lost in a row with the NEW FLAVOUR badge (squashed from a circle into a pill) and the ZERO SUGAR tag, so the button and the badges compete. The yellow circle is cropped and barely visible behind the can, and the bottom row is indented and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge.
